# Repositories and version control configuration

Repository relationships, VCS providers, dispatch, commits, and workspace configuration.

Defaults come from the schema when declared, otherwise from the bundled YAML. An object
with listed children is expanded below; `{…}` and `[…]` summarize compound defaults. A
dash means the schema has no finite allowed-value list.

## `commit_hooks`

| Config key                                                                                        | Type   | Default                                                                            | Allowed values | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| <a id="commit_hooks"></a>`commit_hooks`                                                           | object | {`before`, `after`, `after_rebase`, `after_rebase_timeout_seconds`} (values below) | —              | Commands to run before VCS dispatch, after a commit-producing dispatch succeeds, and after a rebase combines divergent work.                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| <a id="commit_hooks-before"></a>`commit_hooks.before`                                             | string | `""`                                                                               | —              | Command to run before commit dispatch (e.g., 'just fix'). Empty string means disabled.                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| <a id="commit_hooks-after"></a>`commit_hooks.after`                                               | string | `""`                                                                               | —              | Command to run after a commit is created and, where applicable, pushed. Empty string means disabled.                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| <a id="commit_hooks-after_rebase"></a>`commit_hooks.after_rebase`                                 | string | `""`                                                                               | —              | Command to run after a rebase combines divergent work, before pushing the resulting tree. Empty string means disabled. Runs with repository-root cwd and SASE_REBASE_CONTEXT/SASE_REBASE_RESULT environment variables naming the JSON context input and result files. Gate errors fail open and allow the push. |
| <a id="commit_hooks-after_rebase_timeout_seconds"></a>`commit_hooks.after_rebase_timeout_seconds` | number | `10`                                                                               | —              | Wall-clock budget in seconds for after-rebase gate execution: context preparation, command execution, teardown, and result reads share one monotonic deadline. Positive finite seconds, maximum 30. Invalid values warn and skip the gate.                                                                      |

## `sibling_repos`

| Config key                                                                 | Type    | Default | Allowed values | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | ------- | -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| <a id="sibling_repos"></a>`sibling_repos`                                  | array   | `[]`    | —              | Deprecated alias for 'repos.linked'. Still parsed during the compatibility window; prefer 'repos.linked' in new config.                                                                                                     |
| <a id="sibling_repos-item"></a>`sibling_repos[]`                           | object  | not set | —              | —                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| <a id="sibling_repos-item-auto_clone"></a>`sibling_repos[].auto_clone`     | boolean | `false` | —              | Materialize and synchronize this linked repository automatically before each agent launch.                                                                                                                                  |
| <a id="sibling_repos-item-name"></a>`sibling_repos[].name`                 | string  | not set | —              | Stable alias used in prompts, metadata, and SASE_LINKED_REPO\_&lt;NAME&gt;\_DIR env vars.                                                                                                                                   |
| <a id="sibling_repos-item-path"></a>`sibling_repos[].path`                 | string  | not set | —              | Primary checkout path. Relative paths are resolved from the project's primary WORKSPACE_DIR.                                                                                                                                |
| <a id="sibling_repos-item-description"></a>`sibling_repos[].description`   | string  | not set | —              | Human-readable purpose used when generating agent memory for this linked repository.                                                                                                                                        |
| <a id="sibling_repos-item-revision_pin"></a>`sibling_repos[].revision_pin` | string  | not set | —              | Optional pin file relative to the primary checkout root that holds this linked repo's pushed SHA. When set, the commit finalizer commits this sibling first and writes its SHA into the pin file before the primary commit. |

## `vcs_provider`

| Config key                                                                          | Type    | Default                                                         | Allowed values            | Description                                                                                                                    |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| <a id="vcs_provider"></a>`vcs_provider`                                             | object  | {`provider`, `use_project_pr_prefix`, `pr_tags`} (values below) | —                         | Configuration for the VCS provider abstraction layer                                                                           |
| <a id="vcs_provider-provider"></a>`vcs_provider.provider`                           | string  | `"auto"`                                                        | `"git"`, `"hg"`, `"auto"` | Name of the VCS provider ('git', 'hg', or 'auto' for auto-detection)                                                           |
| <a id="vcs_provider-default_hooks"></a>`vcs_provider.default_hooks`                 | array   | not set                                                         | —                         | Override the default required hooks added to new Patches. Each entry is a hook command string (supports '!' and '$' prefixes). |
| <a id="vcs_provider-default_hooks-item"></a>`vcs_provider.default_hooks[]`          | string  | not set                                                         | —                         | —                                                                                                                              |
| <a id="vcs_provider-workspace_root"></a>`vcs_provider.workspace_root`               | string  | not set                                                         | —                         | Root directory for workspaces. Overridden by SASE_WORKSPACE_ROOT env var. Defaults to $HOME/workspace for git.                 |
| <a id="vcs_provider-pr_tags"></a>`vcs_provider.pr_tags`                             | object  | `{}`                                                            | —                         | Key-value tags appended as TAG=VALUE lines to PR commit messages                                                               |
| <a id="vcs_provider-pr_tags-key"></a>`vcs_provider.pr_tags.<key>`                   | string  | not set                                                         | —                         | —                                                                                                                              |
| <a id="vcs_provider-use_project_pr_prefix"></a>`vcs_provider.use_project_pr_prefix` | boolean | `false`                                                         | —                         | Prepend [&lt;project&gt;] to PR titles or PR descriptions.                                                                     |

## `vcs_ref_completion`

| Config key                                                          | Type    | Default                    | Allowed values | Description                                                                             |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | -------------------------- | -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

## `vcs_repo_completion`

| Config key                                                                                | Type    | Default                                                      | Allowed values | Description                                                                       |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| <a id="vcs_repo_completion"></a>`vcs_repo_completion`                                     | object  | {`enabled`, `cache_ttl_seconds`, `max_repos`} (values below) | —              | Repository-name completion inside VCS workflow refs such as #gh:owner/.           |
| <a id="vcs_repo_completion-enabled"></a>`vcs_repo_completion.enabled`                     | boolean | `true`                                                       | —              | Enable repository completion inside VCS workflow refs.                            |
| <a id="vcs_repo_completion-cache_ttl_seconds"></a>`vcs_repo_completion.cache_ttl_seconds` | integer | `600`                                                        | —              | Seconds before cached repository lists are refreshed.                             |

## `workspace`

| Config key                                                                | Type    | Default                    | Allowed values | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | -------------------------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| <a id="workspace"></a>`workspace`                                         | object  | {…} (5 keys; values below) | —              | Workspace directory layout policy (Phase 1+: sase-3p WorkspaceStore).                                                                                                                                                                            |
| <a id="workspace-root"></a>`workspace.root`                               | string  | `"xdg-state"`              | —              | Workspace root policy: 'xdg-state' (default platform state directory), 'adjacent' (legacy opt-in `primary_<num>/` layout), or an absolute path. The `SASE_WORKSPACE_ROOT` environment variable overrides this when set.                          |
| <a id="workspace-project_key"></a>`workspace.project_key`                 | string  | `""`                       | —              | Explicit override for the project_key used to namespace managed workspaces. Empty string means derive from the single Git remote (preferred) or the primary path plus a short hash.                                                              |
| <a id="workspace-share_git_objects"></a>`workspace.share_git_objects`     | boolean | `true`                     | —              | When true, numbered managed workspace clones borrow the primary checkout's Git object database through SASE-managed alternates. Set false to keep standalone clones; `sase workspace repair` dissociates existing SASE-managed borrowers safely. |
| <a id="workspace-cleanup_ttl_days"></a>`workspace.cleanup_ttl_days`       | integer | `14`                       | —              | Days before unclaimed managed workspaces are eligible for `sase workspace cleanup --stale`.                                                                                                                                                      |
| <a id="workspace-held_claim_ttl_days"></a>`workspace.held_claim_ttl_days` | integer | `14`                       | —              | Days before a pinned (held) dead-PID workspace claim is released automatically. Artifacts are kept so the failed run stays dismissible; only the workspace hold is dropped. 0 disables age-based release.                                        |
